item.title: Intent-Driven Development vs Spec-Driven Development: Compass and Map
item.description:
Note: You can read the Spanish (Español) version of this article here.

Imagine you’re building a house. The blueprint tells contractors exactly what to build — room dimensions, door positions, electrical outlets. That’s SDD: precise, enforceable, no ambiguity.

But the blueprint doesn’t explain why you wanted a home office instead of a third bedroom, or why you chose an open kitchen. Six months later, when a contractor asks “can we move this wall?”, nobody can answer without that original reasoning.

item.title: From "Wow It Works!" to "Wow It Still Works"
item.description:
Note: You can read the Spanish (Español) version of this article here.

Making vibecoded apps production-worthy in five steps.

Vibecoding — term popularized by Andrej Karpathy (Feb 2025). Word of the Year 2025 — Collins Dictionary · Merriam-Webster trend.

There’s a dangerous moment in every AI-assisted project: the moment the demo works perfectly on localhost:8000 and the team declares “we’re done.” The button changes color. The data loads. Business sees a finished product. Engineering sees the beginning of the real work.

item.title: Switching Between Multiple Claude Code Accounts (Bedrock SSO + Claude.ai Team)
item.description:
Problem Link to heading

Claude Code stores its auth provider in ~/.claude/settings.json. If your machine is configured for AWS Bedrock SSO (e.g. via corporate setup), it overrides everything — including shell env vars and VSCode workspace settings. Logging out and back in doesn’t help because Bedrock reconnects automatically via AWS credentials.

Root Cause Link to heading
